title: The Silt-Line Compact
subtitle: Navigate Siltport's debt crisis, the Kestrel wreckage, and the Ledger Syndicate's grip on the rim.

stages.title: Dockside Briefing
stages.objective: Speak with Dockmaster Renn at Siltport Outpost — Landing Pad about the Kestrel distress ping.

stages.title: The Kestrel Incident
stages.objective: Jump to the Kestrel Wreckage in the Inner Drift and resolve the breach.

stages.title: Decode the Blackbox
stages.objective: Bring the Kestrel's telemetry to Vexra Korr or SABLE-7 at Siltport Landing Pad to uncover what the Syndicate was hauling.

stages.title: The Missing Fore-Hull
stages.objective: Jump to the Kestrel Fore-Hull in the Mid-Drift to uncover what vitrified the ship and settle Taren's fate.

stages.title: The Rim's Ledger
stages.objective: Investigate Syndicate Buoy 14 in the Mid-Drift to uncover what Vane-Kael is funding with Siltport's tariffs.

stages.title: The Tariff Standoff
stages.objective: Confront Syndicate Collector Vane-Kael at Rust & Cantina Row and decide Siltport's future.

title: The Choir of Ash
subtitle: Trace the Pre-Collapse harmonic signal bleeding through your ship's nav-core to the Singing Monolith.

stages.title: Ghosts in the Nav-Core
stages.objective: Travel to The Cinder Lark — Cockpit and investigate the harmonic echo with SABLE-7.

stages.title: Break the Outer Reef
stages.objective: Upgrade your Ley-Braided Drive or Aether-Spectrum Sensors to Lv. 2 on the Ship tab.

stages.title: The Glass Shoals
stages.objective: Navigate The Glass Shoals in the Deep Frontier to find Captain Tessa's Starling and learn the truth of the Collapse.

stages.title: The Listening Abbey
stages.objective: Visit The Listening Abbey to parley with Cantrix Vey and the Void Choir remnants.

stages.title: Black-Site Anchor-9
stages.objective: Confront Collector Vane-Kael's grounding-lance ring at Anchor-9 before it fires on the Monolith.

stages.title: Answer the Singing Monolith
stages.objective: Jump to The Singing Monolith in the Deep Frontier and decide the Keystone's fate.

stages.title: The Lattice Reckoning
stages.objective: Return to Siltport Outpost — Landing Pad to see how your choices reshaped the Drift.
